climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A large region of the Western Cape, which holds most of South Africa's vineyards, containing Paarl, Stellenbosch, Swartland, Constantia and Franschhoek. Plantings across Paarl, Swartland and Stellenbosch are led by Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz.
